_comment_fields.target: Item IDs or tags to match. Supports exact, wildcard (*), regex:, and negation (!).
_comment_fields.pose: Continuous bedrock pose (is_pose:true, loop:true). Applied while conditions match.
_comment_fields.animation: One-shot bedrock animation (loop:false). Plays once when entry first matches.
_comment_fields.animation_speed: Playback speed for the one-shot animation.
_comment_fields.entity: Entity type filter. Empty = player only. Supports wildcard and negation.
conditions: enchantment: item has enchantment at minimum level.
tag: item belongs to a tag.
has_gun_ammo: held gun has enough ammo to fire.
is_on_cooldown: held item is on a cooldown timer.
is_using_item: player is actively using/holding right-click.
is_not_using_item: player is NOT using any item.
